claims.statement: For every ordinary star T=K_{1,d} with d>=12 and every p satisfying the primary eligibility conditions, the full selected favorable-leaf aggregate S(T,p) is nonpositive.
claims.scope: Only ordinary stars K_{1,d}, d>=12, with the exact x(T)+2<=p and 3p<2alpha(T)+1 guards and the original strict favorable-leaf selector.
claims.reason: retained: the exact strict selector includes every original leaf, and direct evaluation gives each summand C(d-1,k+1)-C(d-1,k)<=0 at every eligible rank. The source report has a factor-k typo in an auxiliary equation, but the claim follows from the defining summands; the corrected matching identity is kS=E-C-kQ=k(U-Q).

limitations: The result covers only ordinary stars K_{1,d} with d>=12 under the stated guards.
It does not establish a cut or compression inequality when H_v has edges, or settle the general ordinary-tree aggregate.
The producer report contains an auxiliary factor-k typo, corrected in this critique; it does not change the restricted claim.
